description: This file contains functions related to firmware upgrade management for Linksys devices within the OpenWrt project. It includes methods to determine the target firmware partition and to perform the upgrade process with specific logic for different firmware formats.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition based on current boot environment and UBI data.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for Linksys devices, selecting the appropriate partition and executing the upgrade based on firmware magic numbers.
